title: [finding] The generic seat-post protocol and the SKILL.md seat mutex still describe a single-occupancy seat, which the director ruling retires for that seat
body:
Filed by the dev executing the director-charter ruling on #16172 as an out-of-scope finding: the ruling was executed in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md` only (the one file that flight held). Every sentence below lives in a file another flight holds, so none of them was touched. ⛔ No `domain:*` and no assignee — the skills seat triages this.

## What the ruling says

The director seat is a decision function: any number of summons run concurrently, no closing brief is owed before another summon starts, and a second summon neither waits for, stands down nor supersedes another. The takeover (接管) and incumbent (在任者) notions are retired **for that seat**.

## The generic protocol text that still assumes exactly one occupant

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md` — the file the director charter points at with 「四段照旧」. Its status vocabulary has no word for a seat with N summons open, which is the specific gap the executing brief asked to be reported:

```
  3:见 SKILL.md 〈座位贴协议〉;本文是接管、移交、回收那一刻要查的协议细则。
  7:- 四段的现值由在任座位在写侧刷新时收缩;⛔ 岗位说明 PR 不代改贴正文。
  9:- 状态词表:`🟢 <github-login>` 在任、`🟢 Routine`、`⏳ vacant`、`⏸️ paused`。
 11:- assignee = 在任 PM 的 GitHub 账号,退场或回收时摘除;无 assignee = 空缺,与标题互为校验。
 13:- 当前 PM 段登记三元:GitHub 账号(`get_me` 自查)、会话 ID 或 Routine ID、上任时刻。
 14:- 审计与认领评论的作者字段是平台盖章的硬读数,接管仲裁与活性判定优先用它对账正文。
 16:- 接管压缩:接任 PM 把交接的有效内容按四段模板重述为新正文,编辑历史即存档。
 34:- 收班序列:贴正文与标题刷新在先,简报评论是最终一笔;继任的释放判据 = 简报在。
 38:- 标题词表不扩,收班座位恒 `⏳ vacant`;留守登记(谁、哪些尾巴)= 说明段一行。
```

Line 9 is the load-bearing one: the four words are `🟢 <github-login>` / `🟢 Routine` / `⏳ vacant` / `⏸️ paused`, and line 38 forbids extending the vocabulary. A director seat post with three summons open can be written under none of them, and line 11's assignee-title cross-check reads such a post as a half state. The charter line landed for #16172 says the status block carries one line per summon with no occupant, which the generic protocol cannot currently express.

## The mutex and takeover sentences in the files other flights hold

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`:

```
 78:- 开轮互斥:fire 开始、首个写动作之前读四个读数,未收班活动任一未满一轮 ⇒ 自退。
 87:- 收班简报是前任不再写的显式声明,是释放标记不是锁:简报即最新事件 ⇒ 立即坐席。
 88:- 维护者明示召唤是仲裁:有简报径直坐席;无简报才走保守确认,确认终止即坐席。
272:- 接管/移交 = 改正文 + 审计评论(评论只作审计不承载状态),接管压缩是标准步骤。
280:- ⛔ 永不从贴的 `updated_at` 或标题推死活;活性只认在任者自己的产出。
```

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/core-rules.md`:

```
 19:- 开轮互斥读四个读数:收班简报、开轮标记、本车道最新他会话认领、最新关闭卡的认领。
```

These stay TRUE for `domain:*` seats, which the ruling did not touch — line 88 is the generic arbitration rule and the ruling is explicitly about the director seat alone. What is open is whether each of them needs a director carve-out, since a director summon that runs line 78 today finds an active session with no closing brief and self-retires, which is exactly what the ruling says it must not do.

## A stale quotation left by this edit

`scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs:720` quotes the director charter's authorization sentence verbatim inside the CEILINGS comment:

```
720:  // file: 「项目总监 由人工定期指挥，负责处理 contract-review 类别的和需要决裁的。」) — a
```

The charter's line was reworded in the same stroke that folded the summon guard into it, so the quotation no longer matches the file it quotes. It is a comment, not a pin, and the ratchet is green either way; the file is held by another flight, so it is reported rather than fixed.

## Dedupe

Listed all open issues over the REST list endpoint (3 pages, 300 entries) and grepped titles for seat / summon / mutex / occupancy / 座位 / director / handover / charter. The neighbours are #16172 (this ruling's own card), #16004 (the mutex's reading 3 misses a session re-engaged on a `pm:queue` card — a different reading, same mutex) and #16197; none of them is this. Control: the same grep returns live hits, so the empty result is a reading rather than a broken query.
